source_scope: Source main pp.2–5 reports three organic molecules blended with commercial SWCNT films, isolated-molecule B3LYP electronic calculations and film measurements. No definite tube chirality or NEGF transport simulation is established. V2 narrows the computational claim to molecular/interfacial evidence and its representativity.

question_to_source_mapping.question: Main pp.4–5 Figure1 and Sections3.1–3.3 discuss molecular energy levels and proposed composite explanation.
question_to_source_mapping.physical_scope: Main p.2 Materials gives tube distribution; p.3 film preparation, p.5 differing loading maxima.

public_facts_to_source_mapping.molecules: Source SI S2–S4 syntheses and corresponding full source coordinate blocks.

previous_scope_correction: 问题限定源分子/材料现象可支持的层次，管模型、吸附姿势、覆盖敏感性和电荷分析方案由 agent 论证；不强制特定 480C 周期单元或未支持 NEGF。
verification_level: Relevant source text/SI reviewed; not all-paper scientific recomputation.
input_limits: Source chirality, interface ensemble and atomistic film morphology are unavailable. A unique sample-matched atomistic interface or transport calculation is input-blocked; evidence from a chosen model must remain conditional.
review_addendum: See the immutable initial plan and its separately dated review addendum; original source files were not modified.
